wins.text: Record AUM of $12.5 trillion; revenue of $5.4B up 13% YoY; operating income up 12%; EPS of $12.05 up 16% YoY — fourth consecutive quarter of 5%+ organic base fee growth
GIP V closed above its $25B target at $25.2B, the largest private infrastructure fund raise in history; HPS closed July 1 adding $165B client AUM and expected ~$450M revenue in Q3 2025
iShares ETF record first-half inflows; IBIT crossed $75B AUM at quarter-end (>$80B as of call date) with $12B net inflows in Q2; active ETFs added $11B; digital asset ETPs added $14B
Technology services and subscription revenue up 26% YoY; ACV grew 32% YoY (16% organically); Preqin added ~$60M to Q2 revenue
$433M net investment gains in Q2 including mark-to-market gains on Circle stake; now managing >$50B for Circle stablecoin cash reserves; tokenized liquidity fund reached $3B AUM

risks.text: Institutional index net outflows of $48B in Q2, driven by a single client redemption of $52B primarily from fixed income, masking underlying organic strength
As-adjusted operating margin of 43.3% was down 80 bps YoY; low-teens percentage increase in 2025 core G&A expected due to GIP, Preqin and HPS onboarding, pressuring near-term margins
Performance fees of $94M decreased from a year ago, reflecting lower performance revenue from private markets, liquid alternatives and long-only products
HPS acquisition issued ~8.5M SubCo units plus ~1M RSUs with potential for up to ~13.8M additional shares of common stock, creating meaningful dilution risk if milestones are achieved
DC/retirement private markets opportunity dependent on litigation reform or regulatory action from DOL/SEC/Congress; proprietary LifePath with privates target date fund not expected until 2026

guidance_items.detail: Q3 base fee run rate estimated ~5% higher than Q2 total base fees (ex-HPS); with HPS, entry rate is ~10% higher; HPS expected to add ~$450M revenue including ~$225M management fees in Q3 2025
Targeting 45%+ adjusted operating margin over the cycle; near-term pressure from acquisition consolidation but path remains clear
Tax rate estimated at ~25% for remainder of 2025; share repurchases of at least $375M/quarter ($1.5B full year) reaffirmed; dividend payout ratio target of 40%-50% of GAAP net income maintained

HPS expected to positively impact effective fee rate by ~0.6 bps; low-teens % increase in 2025 core G&A guided due to acquisition onboarding; $400B gross private markets fundraising target 2025-2030 reiterated

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Specific HPS flow trends and fundraising pipeline for H2 2025 (management did not quantify HPS flows during announcement-to-close period in prepared remarks)
Stablecoin reserve management opportunity and pipeline of mandates beyond Circle (not addressed proactively)
Capital return framework and dividend payout ratio trajectory post-acquisitions (not discussed in prepared remarks)
